title: German Potato Bake
description: A rich and comforting vegan potato bake with a German twist. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and piquant sauce. Toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the bake mix with a splash of non-dairy milk. Pour the mixture evenly over the potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
